description: This file defines interfaces, types, constants, and function prototypes for the LifeVibes audio processing library, including effects like bass enhancement, equalizer, spectrum analysis, and volume control.

methods.name: LVM_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information about the library.

methods.name: LVM_GetMemoryTable
methods.description: Provides memory requirements and allocations for the library instance.

methods.name: LVM_GetInstanceHandle
methods.description: Creates a new audio processing instance and returns its handle.

methods.name: LVM_ClearAudioBuffers
methods.description: Clears internal audio buffers of the instance.

methods.name: LVM_GetControlParameters
methods.description: Retrieves current control parameters of the instance.

methods.name: LVM_SetControlParameters
methods.description: Sets or updates control parameters for the instance.

methods.name: LVM_Process
methods.description: Processes input audio data and applies effects.

methods.name: LVM_GetSpectrum
methods.description: Retrieves spectral information for display purposes.

methods.name: LVM_SetVolumeNoSmoothing
methods.description: Adjusts output volume instantly without smoothing.
